## CELL FACTS

The classical excess idiom for this cell (say it in English in carry.excess, never quote it): 金能生水，水多金沉 (泄之太过, the Expression door).
The eight wide openers (a carry.wide clause opens with one; no core repeats one across its wanted energies): "{Element} is one thing you never run short of" · "{Element} is easy for you to reach" · "{Element} is all around you" · "You have plenty of {Element}" · "{Element} is already here in plenty" · "You are well supplied with {Element}" · "You were given plenty of {Element}" · "There is no shortage of {Element} in you".
Fields shown above that are not the target are context for the repetition law (no four-word run shared with them) and for the cut law; do not rewrite them.

No chart is attached to this batch: the cell is written for every chart with a Metal core, so no percentage, no band and no state of one chart appears in any value (the engine owns the numbers). The pole's band facts come from the pair law and the band table (REA_02 §5c): the catalyst pole of Water as the Expression is the Overfueled band's case (the core has more than it channels), remedy verb Channel; the friction pole of Water as the Expression is the Underfueled band's case (the core burns more than it takes in), remedy verb Refill, cure set Earth (the taming cure by the ten equations, template-level). The states this cell renders (chart.mjs, journeyData.js: the pole's turn, or the carry line for an absent, thin, abundant, dominant or unrooted energy): catalyst_turn, friction_turn, wide, missing, spared, thin, excess. The yin sibling's overrides (mechanism_yin, carry_yin) are not in this batch and keep the station's text.

mechanism.base.value: Metal feeds water, the old texts say: dew beads on the cold blade at dawn, drawn out of the air by the chill of the steel. The edge does not pour. It makes the water by being what it is, hard and cold and exact, and the drops gather on the clean line without any effort of its own. What the blade cannot say, the dew says for it, running off into the ground.

spec.notes: opens on a plain statement of the state in the reader's terms (Water named, its volume in ordinary words, the reference lead-in "With too little Water, …" or any plain statement, never "Run thin," or "Run heavy,"), then the elemental image of the state in one clause that stands alone, what it costs, then ONE plain directive that stands alone, the carry line below is cut from the image clause

mechanism.catalyst_turn.value: With too little Water, the blade stays dry: everything is judged and nothing is said, so the work of the edge never leaves the hand. Say one unfinished thing out loud this week.

function.definition_catalyst.value: Water is your Expression, and as a catalyst, it is the care you hold back and the talent you keep quiet. Since you carry little Water, you judge more than you let flow. You want to be right more than heard, so you keep your kindness and your best ideas waiting too long.

function.definition_friction.value: Water is your Expression, and as a friction, it is care that never stops and talent that stays loud. You pour out more Water than you take in, until every thought gets said. You need to be heard more than refilled, so your care and wit run out before your words do.

spec.remedy_gloss: Channel: an outlet, an action that spends the excess (make, ship, say, lift, walk, cut); never a brake (the band's remedy verb, REA_02 §5c; no chart is attached: the catalyst pole of the Expression is the Overfueled band's case (the core has more than it channels))
spec.notes: one plain truth sentence with the reader as its subject naming the psychological truth under the state, every action in the remedy verb's shape, then small actions with objects and cadences from the family's ruled domains or ordinary life (work only where a domain word is work), three or four, ending on the smallest, no aphorism close; no metaphor stacking; no prescription of investments, careers or medical acts; never a guarantee

function.advise_catalyst.value: You keep being right in private, and that counts for nothing until someone hears it. Send the page before the third read. Tell a child one story with no lesson in it. Once a month, give something you made to someone who did not ask. Say the compliment the moment you think it.

spec.remedy_gloss: Refill: intake, rest, taking in (read, sit, sleep, ask, wait for the whole answer); never a push for more output (the band's remedy verb, REA_02 §5c; no chart is attached: the friction pole of the Expression is the Underfueled band's case (the core burns more than it takes in))

Let it {spend / hold / shape} what {the overgrown element} {stores / pours / burns}." The energy is the subject, a material the reader can hold and use, no life action inside the beat; the element must be in cure_set, never one that feeds this friction; the gate blocks without the "Seek {Element}, the {Function} energy" form; no metaphor stacking; no prescription of investments, careers or medical acts; never a guarantee

function.advise_friction.value: You say the thing to find out what you think, and nothing is left over for you. Read a whole chapter before you answer. Sit with one question overnight. Seek Earth, the Mind energy. Earth is the bank and the ground: it takes water in and holds it until it clears. Let it hold what Water pours.
